title: 第 11 章 全网唾骂天道刻意抹黑第 12 章 我不辩解只看小丑跳梁
lines: 午后的日头高悬在青玄宗上空，燥热的风卷着各处议论声源源不断飘进陆家院落。灵泉重回陆家地界已经过去整整一夜，可整件事的是非黑白，在天道无形的篡改之下已经彻底颠倒，明明是陆衍依靠阵法规矩拿回自家祖产，全宗门上下却统一口径，将他钉在阴险卑劣、用旁门左道抢夺寒门机缘的恶少标签上。
陆衍坐在院中石凳上，指尖摩挲着刚刚稳固下来的炼气巅峰灵力，经过上次良心暴击，他的修为扎扎实实稳固在同阶顶尖水准，【微末气运制衡】被动天赋时时刻刻悄然运转，远处苏辰吸收来的天命金光，会被无形之力悄无声息抽走一小部分。
赵小胖耷拉着脑袋从外面跑回来，小脸满是憋屈：“少爷，外面彻底没法说理了！我跟几个认识的外门师弟解释灵本来就是咱们陆家的地契私产，结果对方像是被人洗脑一样，一口咬定是苏师兄天降机缘被你暗算，多说两句还被一群人围起来嘲讽，差点挨揍。”
老管家周伯紧跟着走入庭院，眉头紧锁：“方才又有两名内门长老遣下人过来传话，委婉警告咱们陆家安分守己，不要再动用隐秘手段算计苏辰，不少世家听闻风声，原本打算和咱们合作的生意，现在全都临时搁置，生怕沾染上打压天才的恶名。”
陆衍神色淡然，端起凉茶抿了一口，早在拿回灵泉之前，他就预判到天道一定会操控舆论搞颠倒黑白，苏辰靠着卖惨收割气运的套路，必然会同步上演。果不其然，话音刚落，门外传来仆从通报，苏辰亲自登门拜访。
一身素色长衫的苏辰缓步走入陆家大门，眉眼依旧带着标志性的温润谦和，明明昨夜损失灵泉、修为倒退是自己粗暴破阵所致，此刻却半点不见怨气，反倒处处摆出体谅大度的模样。刚一见面，苏先是对着陆衍微微拱手，语气柔和：“陆师兄，昨日灵泉变故我反复思索，想来你也是太过看重家族祖业，一时情急才动用特殊办法，我心中并无半点记恨。”
这话刚落地，跟随苏辰一同前来的几名跟班立刻附和吹捧，大肆夸赞苏心胸宽广、以德报怨，换做旁人机缘被夺早就闹上戒律堂，也唯有苏辰心怀宗门大义，愿意体谅陆衍的难处。
苏顺势继续加码，句句暗藏诛心之语：“机缘得失乃是寻常小事，我修炼不靠灵泉加持也能稳步精进，若是陆师兄内心过意不去，日后遇上修炼难题，我还能抽空指点一二。”表面是让步示好，实则变相坐实陆衍心怀狭隘、不择手段抢机缘的事实，话音落下的瞬间，天边淡淡的金色气运源源不断涌入苏辰体内，靠着这番大度说辞，先前因为灵泉流失损耗的气运快速回补。
周遭路过的陆家下人全都憋着一肚子火气，明明自家被抢在先，反倒被对方站在道德制高点指指点点，偏偏受天道规则束缚，但凡想要开口辩驳，喉咙就莫名发紧，话语堵在嘴边怎么都说不出来。
陆衍静静看着苏辰全套表演，心里把对方的算计看得明明白白：先上门假意大度博美名，再借着舆论施压，哪怕不能再次索要灵泉，也能靠着全天下的同情，从宗门库房领到补偿资源，怎么算都是稳赚不赔。
不等陆开口回话，苏话锋一转，看似无意提起过往旧事：“早年我在外历练多次遭遇险境，屡次被人刻意刁难，好在熬到如今才有立足之地，也能理解出身优渥的师兄难以体会寒门谋生的难处。”刻意渲染自身苦难经历，把自己塑造成一路披荆斩棘的可怜天才，再次拔高自身人设，加深全宗门众人对陆衍的负面印象。
短短半个时辰的登门闲谈，苏辰没提半句补偿、没闹半分矛盾，却靠着三言两语，让陆家在舆论层面再跌一截，做完所有铺垫之后，苏辰便带着跟班从容告辞，离开陆家之后立刻吩咐手下弟子加大散播谣言的力度，把陆衍暗中修炼邪术、靠阴法篡改地脉的谣言传遍整个宗门。
短短一个时辰，新的抹黑流言飞速蔓延，从内门传到外门，就连丹峰、剑峰不少中立弟子都被天道潜移默化影响，下意识相信传言，认定陆衍靠着歪门邪道夺走机缘。
陆衍起身走出院落，打算出门闲逛，顺便寻找行善积攒功德的机会，出门刚走没多远，就能听见路边三五成群的弟子扎堆吐槽。“陆衍真是烂泥扶不上墙，坐拥家世还耍阴招，好好的机缘硬是被他抢回去。”“也就苏师兄宅心仁厚，换个脾气火爆的，早就闹到宗主面前讨要说法了。”“往后离陆家远点，免得不小心被他用阴计算计。”
零星几个此前被陆衍出手救治过的弟子想要站出来说公道话，刚说出半句实情，立马被身边同伴强行打断，还被天道带来的莫名心慌感困住，只能无奈闭嘴。天道的规则偏袒已经渗透到日常方方面面，想要靠口头辩解扭转舆论，完全是白费功夫。
一路走来，陆衍能清晰察觉到自身身上的天道厄运buff再度小幅加重，周身灵气运转隐隐出现滞涩，原本顺畅的修行节奏被天道暗中干扰，这就是舆论反噬带来的隐性惩罚，也是天道偏袒天命之子的直观体现。
但连日行善积攒的功德金光萦绕周身，一点点中和负面压制，让厄运没办法彻底影响自身根基。陆衍索性不再纠结眼下漫天唾骂，越是现在被全天下误解，日后真相大白时反转带来的功德收益就越高，索性继续低调游走在外门区域，寻找落难修士，默默积攒翻盘资本。
傍晚时分，陆衍回到陆家别院，刚刚盘膝坐稳，脑海里系统提示音准时响起。【叮！检测当前天道全面扭曲舆论，宿主持续遭受无差别抹黑，发布全新制衡主线任务：破除全网负面谣言，击碎苏辰刻意营造的大度人设。】【任务奖励：海量功德、随机功法，失败则持续承受天道长期气运压制。】
陆衍目光落在系统任务面板上，指尖轻点桌面，心中慢慢盘算后续布局，不急着立刻出面澄清，继续隐忍等待苏辰自己露出更多破绽。
就在陆静心规划下一步行善和布局路线之时，系统额外弹出一条情报提醒：苏辰已经盯上宗门丹阁库存丹药，准备故技重施，借着舆论大势再度上门道德绑架，大批量索要宗门资源，新一轮资源争夺战即将开启。

The afternoon sun hung high over Qingxuanzong, and the hot wind carried the sound of discussions from everywhere into the Lu family courtyard. It had been a whole night since Lingquan returned to the Lu family, but the right and wrong of the whole matter had been completely reversed by the invisible tampering of the law of heaven. It was clearly Lu Yan who relied on the rules of the formation to get back his ancestral property, but the entire sect unanimously labeled him as a sinister and despicable villain who used other methods to seize opportunities from poor families.
Lu Yan was sitting on the stone bench in the courtyard, his fingertips rubbing the newly stabilized Qi Refining peak spiritual power. After the last critical attack of his conscience, his cultivation was firmly at the top level of the same level. The [Micro Luck Check and Balance] passive talent was quietly operating at all times. A small part of the golden light of destiny absorbed by Su Chen in the distance would be quietly taken away by invisible force.
Fatty Zhao ran back from outside with his head drooped, his little face full of aggrievedness: "Master, there is absolutely no reason to explain outside! I explained to a few outer disciples I knew that Ling was originally the private property of our Lu family, but the other party seemed to have been brainwashed and insisted that it was Brother Su who had been lucky enough to be plotted by you. After even a few words, he was surrounded by a group of people and ridiculed, and almost got beaten."
Uncle Zhou, the old butler, followed closely into the courtyard, his brows furrowed: "Just now, two more inner sect elders sent their servants to convey a message, tactfully warning us, the Lu family, to stay safe and not to use secret means to scheme against Su Chen. Many aristocratic families have heard the news, and all the business that they originally planned to cooperate with us has been temporarily shelved, for fear of getting the reputation of suppressing geniuses."
Lu Yan looked indifferent and took a sip of the herbal tea. Long before he took back the spiritual spring, he had predicted that Heaven would definitely manipulate public opinion to confuse right and wrong, and Su Chen's trick of reaping misfortune and reaping luck would inevitably be staged at the same time. Sure enough, as soon as he finished speaking, a servant announced outside the door that Su Chen came to visit in person.
Su Chen, dressed in a plain gown, walked slowly into the Lu family's gate, with his signature gentleness and humility in his eyes. It was clear that the loss of the spiritual spring and the regression in cultivation last night were caused by his violent break in the formation, but at this moment, he showed no resentment at all, and instead acted considerate and generous. As soon as they met, Su Xian slightly bowed his hand to Lu Yan and said in a soft tone: "Senior Brother Lu, I have thought about the incident in Lingquan yesterday. It seems that you value the family legacy too much and only resorted to special measures in a moment of urgency. I don't hold any grudge in my heart."
As soon as these words were spoken, several of the followers who came with Su Chen immediately echoed the compliments, praising Su's broad-mindedness and repaying evil with kindness. Others would have gone to the Discipline Hall if their opportunity had been taken away, but Su Chen was the only one who had the righteousness of the sect and was willing to understand Lu Yan's difficulties.
Su took advantage of the situation and continued to add more words, with heart-breaking words hidden in every sentence: "The gains and losses of opportunities are ordinary trivial matters. I can make steady progress in cultivation without relying on the blessing of the spiritual spring. If Senior Brother Lu feels guilty and encounters problems in cultivation in the future, I can still find time to give you some advice." On the surface, he gave in. The show of goodwill was actually a covert attempt to confirm the fact that Lu Yan was narrow-minded and would use any means to seize opportunities. The moment the words fell, a steady stream of golden luck from the horizon poured into Su Chen's body. With these generous words, the luck that had been lost due to the loss of the spiritual spring was quickly replenished.
The servants of the Lu family who were passing by were all holding back their anger. They were obviously beaten first, but instead they were pointed at by the other party who stood on the moral high ground. However, they were bound by the rules of heaven. Whenever they wanted to open their mouths to argue, their throats would become inexplicably tight, and the words would be stuck in their mouths and they could not come out.
Lu Yan quietly watched Su Chen's full performance, and he understood the other party's plan clearly in his heart: he would first come to the door and pretend to be generous, and then use public opinion to put pressure on him. Even if he could not ask for the spiritual spring again, he could still rely on the sympathy of the whole world to receive compensation resources from the sect's treasury. No matter how he calculated, he would make a sure profit without losing anything.
Before Lu could reply, Su changed the subject, seemingly unintentionally bringing up the past: "In my early years, I encountered many dangers while working abroad, and was deliberately made difficult for many times. Fortunately, I have survived until now. I can understand that it is difficult for seniors from a privileged background to understand the difficulties of making a living in a poor family." Deliberately exaggerating his own suffering experience, portraying himself as a pitiful genius who has overcome all obstacles along the way, he once again elevated his personality and deepened the negative impression of the entire sect on Lu Yan.
In just half an hour of chatting at the door, Su Chen didn't say a word of compensation or make any conflicts, but with a few words, the Lu family's public opinion dropped further. After all the preparations were made, Su Chen left calmly with his followers. After leaving the Lu family, he immediately ordered his disciples to increase the intensity of spreading rumors, and spread the rumors throughout the sect that Lu Yan secretly practiced evil arts and used yin methods to tamper with the earth's veins.
In just one hour, new slanderous rumors spread rapidly, from the inner sect to the outer sect. Even many neutral disciples at Danfeng and Jianfeng were subtly influenced by Heavenly Dao. They subconsciously believed the rumors and concluded that Lu Yan had used crooked ways to steal the opportunity.
Lu Yan got up and walked out of the courtyard, intending to go out for a stroll and look for opportunities to do good deeds and accumulate merit. Not far after he went out, he could hear groups of disciples on the roadside making complaints. "Lu Yan really can't stand up to the wall. He has a good family background and plays dirty tricks. He just snatched away the good opportunity." "Senior brother Su has a kind heart. If he had a hot temper, he would have gone to the sect master to ask for an explanation." "Stay away from the Lu family in the future, so as not to be accidentally plotted by him."
A few disciples who had been treated by Lu Yan before wanted to stand up and speak out. As soon as they told half of the truth, they were immediately forcibly interrupted by their companions. They were also trapped by the inexplicable panic brought by the way of heaven, and they had no choice but to shut up. The rules and favoritism of heaven have penetrated into every aspect of daily life. It is completely useless to try to change public opinion by relying on verbal justification.
Along the way, Lu Yan could clearly notice that the Heavenly Dao's bad luck buff on his body had slightly worsened again. The movement of spiritual energy around his body was faintly stagnant. The originally smooth practice rhythm was secretly interfered with by Heavenly Dao. This was the hidden punishment brought about by the backlash of public opinion, and it was also an intuitive manifestation of Heavenly Dao favoring the children of destiny.
However, the golden light of merit accumulated by doing good deeds over the past few days lingers around the body, neutralizing the negative suppression bit by bit, preventing bad luck from completely affecting one's own foundation. Lu Yan simply stopped worrying about the reviled people in the world right now. The more he was misunderstood by the whole world now, the higher the merit benefits would be from turning around when the truth is revealed in the future. He simply continued to wander around the outer gate area in a low profile, looking for monks in distress, and silently accumulating capital for a comeback.
In the evening, Lu Yan returned to the Lu Family Courtyard. He had just sat cross-legged and settled down when the system notification sounded in his mind on time. 【bite! Detecting the current comprehensive distortion of public opinion by Heavenly Law, the host continues to suffer indiscriminate slander, and releases a new main task of checks and balances: to break negative rumors on the entire network, and to crush the generous persona that Su Chen deliberately created. 】【Task reward: massive merit and random skills. If you fail, you will continue to suffer the long-term fate suppression of heaven. 】
Lu Yan's eyes fell on the system task panel, and he tapped the desktop with his fingertips. He slowly considered the follow-up plan in his mind. He was not in a hurry to come forward to clarify immediately, and continued to wait patiently for Su Chen to reveal more flaws.
Just when Lu Jing was planning his next good deed and layout route, an additional intelligence reminder popped up in the system: Su Chen had set his sights on the sect's Dan Pavilion's inventory of elixirs and was preparing to repeat his old tricks. Taking advantage of the trend of public opinion, he once again came to the door for moral kidnapping and demanded sect resources in large quantities. A new round of resource competition was about to begin.
